# noozle_gcp_pubsub_outlet (Data Source)

Reads a Noozle GCP Pub/Sub outlet by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "noozle_gcp_pubsub_outlet" "alerts" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the outlet.

### Read-Only

- `applied_generation` (Number) Last observed applied config generation.
- `apply_status` (String) Observed apply/runtime status for the outlet.
- `batching_byte_size` (Number) Maximum bytes per Pub/Sub batch.
- `batching_check` (String) Bloblang condition for flushing a Pub/Sub batch.
- `batching_count` (Number) Maximum messages per Pub/Sub batch.
- `batching_jitter` (Number) Randomized jitter to apply to the Pub/Sub batching period.
- `batching_period` (String) Maximum wait period before flushing a Pub/Sub batch.
- `byte_threshold` (Number) Publish when the Pub/Sub buffer reaches this many bytes.
- `config_generation` (Number) Desired outlet config generation.
- `count_threshold` (Number) Publish when the Pub/Sub buffer reaches this many messages.
- `delay_threshold` (String) Publish a non-empty Pub/Sub buffer after this delay.
- `description` (String) Optional note explaining the outlet purpose.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the outlet is active.
- `endpoint` (String) Optional Google Cloud Pub/Sub API endpoint override.
- `flow_control_limit_exceeded_behavior` (String) Behavior when the Pub/Sub flow-control buffer is full.
- `flow_control_max_outstanding_bytes` (Number) Maximum buffered Pub/Sub bytes waiting to be published.
- `flow_control_max_outstanding_messages` (Number) Maximum buffered Pub/Sub messages waiting to be published.
- `last_apply_error` (String) Last observed apply/runtime error message.
- `max_in_flight` (Number) Maximum number of in-flight Pub/Sub messages.
- `metadata_exclude_prefixes` (List of String) Metadata prefixes to exclude from Pub/Sub attributes.
- `name` (String) Name presented for the outlet.
- `notify_policy` (String) Delivery policy applied when notifying this outlet.
- `ordering_key` (String) Pub/Sub ordering key interpolation.
- `project` (String) Google Cloud project ID.
- `publish_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait before abandoning a Pub/Sub publish attempt.
- `topic` (String) Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic.
- `transform` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform))

Read-Only:

- `applied` (Boolean)
- `effective` (String)
- `generation` (Number)
